newsitem.title: GREECE: OTE flotation to be completed by end-June.
newsitem.headline: OTE flotation to be completed by end-June.

text.p: OTE telecom officials told a news conference on Wednesday they are expecting OTE'S flotation procedure to be completed by end June.
"There is a strong belief that the flotation will be over by the end of June and this is highly desirable," said OTE's chairman Dimitris Papoulias.
The Greek cabinet will convene on Friday to finalise its decision on OTE's second flotation.
Up to 25.0 percent of the telecommunications company could be floated following the 8.0 percent tranche the first time around, in the spring of 1996.

"There are no disputes between OTE and the finance and transportation ministries which are handling the flotation issue. Everything is going smoothly and we are awaiting their decision on Friday," added Papoulias.
With OTE looking to expand outside Greece, the timing of other foreign telecoms coming to market will determine the exact period when OTE's flotation will take place, added Papoulias.
The joint global coordinators for the flotation will be the National Bank of Greece SA, Salomon Brothers International and HSBC Investment Bank plc, an HSBC manager told Reuters.
OTE officials also said that their company is proceeding with its qualitative upgrading through the launch of ISDN services, aided by Siemens and Intracom.
OTE shares gained 165 drachmas to close at 6,010 on Wednesday.
